mcp.note: Final formula (LEDGER.md section 2d): n_total=2*ceil(x*(1+ratio)/2), smaller group ceiled directly, larger group derived as n_total-smaller. This row was one of the two live Frida probes used to find that formula. Matches the GUI exactly, and the formula scores 30/30 on the full oracle/t2_indep_vectors.csv set (see ASSUMPTIONS.md section 1 for the full history of earlier, lower-scoring hypotheses).
